Container.Name: MakerWorks-v2
Container.Overview:
MakerWorks v2 is a self-hosted 3D model hub with STL previews, price estimation, optional Stripe checkout, and an admin dashboard for site settings, pricing, backups, and OrderWorks job monitoring. Point it at any reachable Postgres 15+ instance and map a persistent storage share for uploaded models, covers, avatars, and backups.
Unraid note: "Autostart" starts the container when the array/Docker service starts, but crash recovery still depends on Docker restart policy. If the container stops, check its logs: the image startup sequence runs restore, Prisma migrations, admin bootstrap, and then the Next.js server.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port the MakerWorks Next.js server listens on

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory for uploaded models, covers, and avatars

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Persistent backup destination (set BACKUP_DIR to this container path)

Config.Name: Bulk Import Folder
Config.Description: Optional mapped folder used by the bulk upload script. Put source STL/OBJ/3MF/AMF/PLY/WRL/VRML/GLB/GLTF/USD/USDZ/USDA/USDC/ZIP files here and run the importer against /app/imports.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Postgres connection string (must be reachable from the container)

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Redis connection string used for BullMQ processing queues

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public URL users access (used for redirects/cookies)

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign user sessions (set to a long random string)

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Email for the bootstrap administrator account

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the bootstrap administrator (rotated on change)

Config.Name: ADMIN_NAME
Config.Description: Display name for the bootstrap administrator account

Config.Name: STORAGE_DIR
Config.Description: Internal storage path (leave at /app/storage unless customizing)

Config.Name: DIRECT_UPLOAD_URL
Config.Description: Optional direct hostname (e.g., https://upload.example.com) used only for uploads to bypass Cloudflare/Tunnel size limits

Config.Name: BULK_UPLOAD_DIR
Config.Description: Default in-container folder scanned by the bulk upload importer

Config.Name: BULK_UPLOAD_BASE_URL
Config.Description: URL used by the bulk upload importer when run inside the container. Leave at http://127.0.0.1:3000 for Unraid.

Config.Name: S3_BUCKET
Config.Description: Optional S3 bucket (leave blank to store uploads locally on STORAGE_DIR)

Config.Name: S3_REGION
Config.Description: Region/endpoint for the S3 bucket (e.g., us-east-1)

Config.Name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
Config.Description: Access key for the configured S3-compatible storage

Config.Name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
Config.Description: Secret key for the configured S3-compatible storage

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true when BASE_URL is HTTPS so auth cookies are secure

Config.Name: SKIP_DOCKER
Config.Description: Set to 1 on Unraid/non-compose runtimes so backups/restores use local client tools instead of docker compose exec

Config.Name: BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Backup destination inside the container. Must point to a mapped path (recommended: /app/backups).

Config.Name: PG_DUMP_BIN
Config.Description: Path to pg_dump binary used by backup when SKIP_DOCKER=1 (or docker compose path fails)

Config.Name: PSQL_BIN
Config.Description: Path to psql binary used by restore when SKIP_DOCKER=1 (or docker compose path fails)

Config.Name: BACKUP_DOCKER_SERVICE
Config.Description: Docker Compose DB service name used for pg_dump/psql when compose mode is enabled

Config.Name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable daily scheduled backups (1=true, 0=false)

Config.Name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE_TIME_UTC
Config.Description: Daily backup time in UTC (HH:mm)

Config.Name: BACKUP_RUN_ON_START
Config.Description: Run one backup when scheduler starts (1=true, 0=false)

Config.Name: BACKUP_PRUNE_ON_BACKUP
Config.Description: Prune old backups immediately after each successful backup

Config.Name: BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Keep backups newer than this many days (0 disables age-based retention)

Config.Name: BACKUP_RETENTION_MAX_COUNT
Config.Description: Always keep at least this many newest backups (0 disables count-based retention)

Config.Name: PROCESSING_QUEUE_ATTEMPTS
Config.Description: Queue retry attempts before moving a failed job to dead-letter handling

Config.Name: PROCESSING_QUEUE_BACKOFF_MS
Config.Description: Exponential backoff delay (ms) between queue retries

Config.Name: IMAGE_WORKER_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Concurrency for image processing workers (used by worker container)

Config.Name: PREVIEW_WORKER_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Concurrency for preview processing workers (used by worker container)

Config.Name: PRINTER_PROFILE
Config.Description: Printer preset for speed/energy math (BAMBU_X1C, BAMBU_P1S, PRUSA_MK4, PRUSA_MK3S, CREALITY_K1_MAX, CREALITY_ENDER3_V2, ANYCUBIC_KOBRA2, GENERIC_FDM)

Config.Name: PRINTER_ELECTRIC_RATE_PER_KWH
Config.Description: Electricity rate (per kWh) used for energy estimates

Config.Name: PLA_PRICE_PER_KG_USD
Config.Description: Price of a 1kg PLA spool (USD) used for estimator

Config.Name: PETG_PRICE_PER_KG_USD
Config.Description: Price of a 1kg PETG spool (USD) used for estimator

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PLA_PRICE_PER_KG
Config.Description: Expose PLA per-kg cost to the client (used for cart price previews)

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PETG_PRICE_PER_KG
Config.Description: Expose PETG per-kg cost to the client

Config.Name: COLOR_SURCHARGE_RATE
Config.Description: Extra cost rate per additional color beyond the first (server-side)

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_COLOR_SURCHARGE_RATE
Config.Description: Expose the color surcharge rate to the client UI

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_CART_COLORS
Config.Description: How many color slots the cart exposes (raise to 8+ if you have multiple AMS units)

Config.Name: CURRENCY
Config.Description: Back-end currency (USD or CAD)

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CURRENCY
Config.Description: Client-facing currency label (must match CURRENCY)

Config.Name: PLA_PRICE_PER_KG_CAD
Config.Description: Optional CAD override for PLA per-kg cost

Config.Name: PETG_PRICE_PER_KG_CAD
Config.Description: Optional CAD override for PETG per-kg cost

Config.Name: ENERGY_CAD_PER_HOUR
Config.Description: Optional CAD override for energy rate per hour

Config.Name: MINIMUM_PRICE_CAD
Config.Description: Optional CAD minimum price override

Config.Name: EXTRA_HOURLY_AFTER_FIRST_USD
Config.Description: Extra hourly surcharge after first hour (USD context)

Config.Name: EXTRA_HOURLY_AFTER_FIRST_CAD
Config.Description: Extra hourly surcharge after first hour (CAD context)

Config.Name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Stripe secret key (starts with sk_live_ or sk_test_)

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
Config.Description: Stripe publishable key used by the in-app checkout UI

Config.Name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Stripe webhook signing secret for /api/stripe/webhook

Config.Name: STRIPE_SHIPPING_RATE_ID
Config.Description: Stripe shipping rate ID required when shipped checkout is enabled

Config.Name: STRIPE_INVOICE_DAYS_UNTIL_DUE
Config.Description: Days until due for Stripe invoices sent from invoice checkout

Config.Name: STRIPE_TAX_ENABLED
Config.Description: Set to 1 after Stripe Tax registrations and product tax settings are configured

Config.Name: PRINTLAB_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Internal PrintLab URL reachable from the MakerWorks container on the shared Docker network

Config.Name: PRINTLAB_AUTH_HEADER
Config.Description: Optional Authorization header for MakerWorks-to-PrintLab admin API calls, for example a Basic or Bearer value

Config.Name: PRINTLAB_SESSION_COOKIE
Config.Description: Optional PrintLab session cookie for MakerWorks-to-PrintLab admin API calls

Config.Name: PRINTLAB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional PrintLab API key for MakerWorks-to-PrintLab API calls when PrintLab is configured to accept one

Config.Name: PRINTLAB_API_KEY_HEADER
Config.Description: Header name used with PRINTLAB_API_KEY

Config.Name: MAKERWORKS_INBOUND_SECRET
Config.Description: Shared secret MakerWorks expects for inbound job updates to /api/makerworks/jobs (send via Authorization Bearer token or MakerWorks signature header)

Config.Name: PRINTLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Shared secret expected on PrintLab callbacks into MakerWorks

Config.Name: STOCKWORKS_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Internal StockWorks URL reachable from the MakerWorks container on the shared Docker network

Config.Name: STOCKWORKS_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Optional StockWorks admin username for MakerWorks-to-StockWorks inventory checks

Config.Name: STOCKWORKS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional StockWorks admin password for MakerWorks-to-StockWorks inventory checks

Config.Name: STOCKWORKS_USERNAME
Config.Description: Optional StockWorks username fallback

Config.Name: STOCKWORKS_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional StockWorks password fallback

Config.Name: STOCKWORKS_COLOR_OVERRIDES
Config.Description: Optional JSON color override map for StockWorks filament availability

Config.Name: HOLIDAY_THEME
Config.Description: Optional seasonal theme: christmas, halloween, easter, valentines, or maythefourth

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL
Config.Description: Contact email shown on the site

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND_NAME
Config.Description: Display name shown across the storefront and emails

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND_VERSION
Config.Description: Optional suffix shown next to the logo (leave blank to hide)

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND_LAB_NAME
Config.Description: Label used for the pickup location in checkout copy

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND_HANDLE
Config.Description: Default handle placeholder for social profile fields

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: SMTP host for verification emails

Config.Name: SMTP_PORT
Config.Description: SMTP port

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: SMTP username

Config.Name: SMTP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: SMTP password

Config.Name: SMTP_SECURE
Config.Description: Use TLS/SSL (true/false) depending on your SMTP provider

Config.Name: RECEIPT_FROM_EMAIL
Config.Description: From address for verification/receipt emails

Config.Name: RECEIPT_REPLY_TO_EMAIL
Config.Description: Reply-to address for outgoing emails

Config.Name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional bot token used for Discord announcements

Config.Name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: Discord channel ID used for announcements

Config.Name: DISCORD_ADMIN_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bot token used for admin notifications (falls back to DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN when unset)

Config.Name: DISCORD_ADMIN_CHANNEL_ID
Config.Description: Discord channel ID for admin-only alerts (new users/uploads)
